videos.setting: bright white bathroom, white hallway/garage shelves, light oak kitchen counter

shots.words: You prepared for the power to go out
shots.still: Close-up in a bright hallway: a hand holds a small black LED flashlight pointed slightly down, thumb on its button; behind it, softly out of focus, a white wire shelf with gallon water jugs and canned food. The flashlight is off.
shots.motion: The thumb presses the button once and the flashlight turns on (a soft white beam); the hand tilts it a few degrees. Slow push-in. The room stays fully bright.

shots.words: but did you prepare for the toilet to stop working
shots.still: A clean white toilet with the lid closed in a bright white bathroom with white subway tile and a frosted daylight window, seen from standing height a little to the side.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth dolly-in toward the closed toilet. Nothing in the room moves.

shots.words: Most people stock up on water food and flashlights but forget about the bathroom
shots.still: A white garage storage shelf, eye level: rows of bottled water and gallon jugs, canned food, two black flashlights and a pack of batteries, neatly stocked, bright daylight.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow sideways tracking move along the shelf from the water to the canned food to the flashlights. Nothing on the shelf moves.

shots.words: That's where these Cleanwaste toilet kits come in
shots.still: On a light oak kitchen counter, the box stands upright on its long edge facing the camera straight on; one hand grips its right end (thumb on the front corner, fingers around the side). White kitchen behind, softly out of focus.
shots.motion: The hand slides the box a few centimetres toward the camera and holds it steady facing the lens; it never turns or tilts more than a few degrees. Slow push-in.

shots.words: Each kit has a waste bag with powder that gels liquid and helps control odor
shots.still: Close-up on a light oak counter: an opened kit pouch lies flat; one hand pinches the corner of the folded blue-grey waste bag, half pulled out of the pouch.
shots.motion: The hand slowly pulls the folded blue-grey waste bag the rest of the way out of the pouch and holds it up a little toward the lens. The bag stays folded and plain.

shots.words: You also get toilet paper a hand wipe and a zip close disposal bag
shots.still: Top-down view of a light oak counter: the kit contents laid out in a neat row.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth push-in from above. Nothing on the counter moves.

shots.words: You can even use it with a regular toilet that won't flush
shots.still: Bright white bathroom: a white toilet with the lid up and the seat down; two hands from the bottom edge hold the opened, empty blue-grey waste bag by its top edge, spreading it over the seat opening.
shots.motion: The hands lower the empty bag into the bowl and fold its edge over the seat, then let go. The bag stays empty and clean. The toilet stays still.

shots.words: It's one less thing to figure out during an emergency
shots.still: An open clear plastic storage bin on a white hall-closet shelf, packed with emergency supplies: bottled water, a flashlight, a red first-aid pouch, and the orange Cleanwaste box standing at the front. Bright daylight.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth dolly-in toward the bin. Nothing moves.

shots.words: Add these to your emergency supplies
shots.still: Same white hall-closet bin of emergency supplies (water, flashlight, first-aid pouch); one hand grips the right end of the box, holding it just above the open bin, print facing the camera.
shots.motion: The hand lowers the box into the bin so it stands at the front, print facing the camera, then the hand leaves the frame. Slow push-in.

videos.setting: pale sage tile bathroom, pale grey stone counter, laundry room, garage, SUV trunk

shots.words: This is the kind of thing you buy before you are desperate
shots.still: The box lying flat on a white laundry-room shelf, front facing the camera, a folded towel stack and a white basket beside it, light grey wall, bright daylight, low three-quarter angle.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth arc and push-in toward the box. Nothing moves.

shots.words: Most people stock up on water, food and flashlights, and forget the bathroom
shots.still: A light wood pantry shelf stocked with water bottles and canned food; one hand from the right edge holds a yellow flashlight just above the shelf.
shots.motion: The hand sets the flashlight down on the shelf next to the cans and leaves the frame. Slow push-in.

shots.words: No water, or a well pump with no power, and that toilet won't flush
shots.still: A white toilet with the lid closed in a bright bathroom with pale sage green tile and a white vanity, low angle from the side.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth sideways dolly past the toilet. Nothing moves.

shots.still: Pale grey stone counter, white backsplash: one hand grips the left end of the box, which stands on its long edge facing the camera.
shots.motion: The hand slides the box a little toward the lens and holds it steady facing the camera. Slow push-in.

shots.words: Each one has a waste bag with powder that gels liquid and helps control odor
shots.still: Close-up: one hand holds the folded blue-grey waste bag by its top edge against the pale grey stone counter.
shots.motion: The hand unfolds the empty bag once so it opens a little, then holds it still. Slow push-in.

shots.words: Then toilet paper, a hand wipe, and a zip bag to seal it
shots.still: Low angle across the pale grey stone counter: the kit contents laid out in a loose fan.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth arc around the items. Nothing moves.

shots.words: It fits your regular toilet, and it all goes out with the trash
shots.still: Pale sage tile bathroom: a white toilet, lid up, seat down, the empty blue-grey bag already folded over the seat opening; one hand from the right edge smooths its edge on the seat.
shots.motion: The hand smooths the bag edge around the seat and leaves the frame. The bag stays empty.

shots.words: Honestly, I'm mad I waited this long
shots.still: A grey garage shelf with a clear storage bin holding a radio, water bottles, a flashlight and the box at the front. Bright daylight from an open garage door.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth dolly-in toward the bin. Nothing moves.

shots.words: Winter storms are coming, and there are twelve kits in a box
shots.still: Top-down on the pale grey stone counter: the box open, its inside showing the kit pouches standing in a row (twelve); one hand pinches the top of one pouch.
shots.motion: The hand lifts one pouch straight up out of the row and holds it. The other pouches stay put.

shots.words: Grab one for the house and one for the car. It's in the orange cart.
shots.still: Open SUV trunk in daylight, a grey trunk organizer holding a jumper cable bag and a water bottle; one hand grips the end of the box, holding it just above the organizer, print facing the camera.
shots.motion: The hand sets the box into the trunk organizer, print facing the camera, and leaves the frame. Slow push-in.
